intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Hutchinson for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 5 (the Light Up Hutch Christmas Parade and the Hutch Rec gingerbread decorating with Santa) through December 27 (the last Holiday Lights night at Hutchinson Zoo), with the Hyde Park Luminaries (December 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Hutchinson

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Hutchinson
  • 3 free events: the Hutch Rec Gingerbread House Decorating with Santa, the Hyde Park Luminaries and the Light Up Hutch Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: the Hutch Rec gingerbread decorating event at Memorial Hall
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Light Up Hutch Christmas Parade on Main Street (December 5)
  • Trains: Holiday Lights at Hutchinson Zoo is listed by Visit Hutch with train rides and pedal boats
  • Season: December 5 to December 27

Planning a bigger day out? Hutchinson families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Wichita, which covers Illuminations at Botanica, Victorian Christmas at Old Cowtown Museum, The Nutcracker and Gingerbread Village.
